Option.ContribEnabled.Label: Enable Contribution
Option.ContribEnabled.Desc: Help crowdsource asset data to the Cities 2 Asset Database. A game restart is required to change the state for the future sessions.
Option.PackCount.Label: Package Count
Option.PackCount.Desc: The maximum number of packages to submit in one session.
Option.Cooldown.Label: Cooldown
Option.Cooldown.Desc: The minimum number of minutes to wait before rechecking submission request.
Option.ResetConsent.Label: Reset Consent
Option.ResetConsent.Desc:
Clears saved consent choices. A prompt to review and set preferences will appear during your next session.
For data deletion requests, please contact on Discord or the Paradox forum.
Option.PrivacyPolicy.Label: Privacy Policy
Option.PrivacyPolicy.Desc: Open the Privacy Policy page in a browser and read how your data is collected, used, and protected.
GeneralConsentText: Do you agree to share asset data from your game with the Cities 2 Asset Database?
UsernameConsentText: Would you like your username "{username}" to appear in the contributor list?
